I need to find a way to measure 45 minutes using two ropes that burn in one hour but not uniformly. let me think. if i light both ends of one rope, it will burn twice as fast. so that would take 30 minutes. but how to get 45 minutes? maybe light one rope at both ends and the other at one end at the same time. when the first rope is done in 30 minutes, the second rope has 30 minutes left. then light the other end of the second rope. since it has 30 minutes left, burning from both ends would take 15 minutes. so total 30 + 15 = 45 minutes. that seems right.
final_answer:
to measure exactly 45 minutes, follow these steps:

1. light both ends of the first rope and one end of the second rope at the same time.
2. when the first rope is completely burned (after 30 minutes), light the other end of the second rope.
3. the second rope will then take 15 more minutes to burn completely.

this totals 45 minutes.
